text: The owned patch removes the packaged accountSetup.css and its aboutImport link, then loads common and preferences styles directly. The import stylesheet keeps the selected root/body layout, description line height and result-indent rules. The actual import code assigns result-indent to its profile-details dl, and description paragraphs already have a local margin reset. Review-questioned margin/padding additions are absent from the owned final source; the requested blank-line grouping is present. The connector uses the border token for its normal state. This bounded source migration does not establish visual or accessibility equivalence for every removed account-setup rule.
title: The import page replaces its account-setup stylesheet dependency with scoped local rules
